name: id
description: The ID of the visually hidden component.

name: text
description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the visually hidden component. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the visually hidden component. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire visually hidden component in a `call` block.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the visually hidden component.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the visually hidden component.

name: element
description: HTML element for the visually hidden component – for example, `"span"`, `"p"`, `"h2"` or `"h3"`. Defaults to `"span"`.

name: slots
description: Specified points for injecting custom content relative to the visually hidden component.

params.name: before
params.description: Custom content injected before the visually hidden component.

params.name: text
params.description: Custom text injected before the visually hidden component.

params.name: html
params.description: Custom HTML injected before the visually hidden component.

params.name: start
params.description: Custom content injected at the start, within the visually hidden component.

params.name: text
params.description: Custom text injected at the start, within the visually hidden component.

params.name: html
params.description: Custom HTML injected at the start, within the visually hidden component.

params.name: end
params.description: Custom content injected at the end, within the visually hidden component.

params.name: text
params.description: Custom text injected at the end, within the visually hidden component.

params.name: html
params.description: Custom HTML injected at the end, within the visually hidden component.

params.name: after
params.description: Custom content injected after the visually hidden component.

params.name: text
params.description: Custom text injected after the visually hidden component.
